meta.name: oalders-docker
meta.description: Docker CLI mixin: the CLI plugins dir (/usr/libexec/docker — where `docker compose` and `docker buildx` actually live), both daemon socket paths (/var/run is a symlink to /run on Linux), plus a narrow slice of ~/.docker (contexts, buildx state, config.json). Net-free: image pulls run in the daemon outside the sandbox, so nothing traverses the session proxy.
